title: MASEMiner
tagline: Extract correlations and study metadata from primary studies for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling
description: MASEMiner — Direct information variant.  Extracts pairwise correlations (from text and tables) and coded study metadata.  The matching Indirect-information variant (masem-tas20) extracts factor loadings and factor correlations instead.
task_description: Extract pairwise correlations (from text and tables) and coded study/sample metadata for every sample reported in the paper.
context: MASEMiner workflow for primary studies that report correlations directly (correlation matrices or pairwise correlations in prose).
